abilities.name: Battle Preparation
abilities.text: During Army Building, your army cannot include both the Nova Assault Mode Unit and the Nova Stealth Mode Unit.

abilities.name: Tactical Stealth Suit
abilities.text: After this Unit fully resolves an Action, it gains the HIDDEN Status.

abilities.name: Ghost Visor
abilities.text: While Enemy Units are Within 6″ of this Unit, they lose the HIDDEN Status.

abilities.name: Super Stimpack
abilities.text: This Unit gains BUFF Speed (2). Additionally, all its Weapons gain PRECISION (2).

abilities.name: Holo Decoy
abilities.text: Resolve the SUMMON (Holo Decoy) effect. Then, Holo Decoy may immediately perform a Move action.

abilities.name: Operational Efficiency
abilities.text: After this Unit fully resolves a Ranged Attack with its C-20A Canister Rifle, if the target Enemy Unit was Destroyed or its Current Supply Value was reduced, the active player may return one of their Exhausted non-Unique Tactical Cards to its Ready state.

abilities.name: Head Shot
abilities.text: Once Per Game. While this Unit is Unengaged and has the Stationary Status, when it makes a Ranged Attack with its C-20A Canister Rifle, treat that weapon's Damage characteristic as 3, and it gains CONCENTRATED FIRE (1).
